newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Woventex debuts at 6.50 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Woventex debuts at 6.50 rgt.

text.p: Shares of Malaysian industrial plastic bag maker Woventex Corporation Bhd debuted on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) on Wednesday at 6.50 ringgit against an offer price of 2.10 ringgit.
The company had offered 3.82 million shares to the Malaysian public, and an additional 1.68 million shares to approved ethnic Malay investors, all at the same offer price.
The company is listed on the KLSE's Second Board.
Woventex is a maker of polypropylene and polyethylene woven bags and fabrics for use in the fertiliser and animal feeds industries.
At 0135 GMT, the stock was trading at 6.65, and within a range of 6.50 and 6.95 on a volume of 347,000 shares.
